items.source: Timbre listens to an audio file of yours, finds the beat and drafts the chords bar by bar.

items.source: The free plan keeps %lld songs. Timbre Pro keeps as many as you like.

items.key: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.source: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.translation: 這會從此裝置移除已儲存的練習、連續紀錄和嗓音進度。

items.key: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.source: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.translation: 所有課堂與歌曲、所有調弦與工具。

items.key: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.source: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.translation: 觸覺調音會依琴弦與目標音的拍頻產生脈動；兩者越接近，脈動越慢，音準鎖定時便停止。

items.key: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.source: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.translation: 移調夾與移調只會改變顯示的音名，不會改變 Timbre 測量的音高。

items.source: Enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.translation: 請輸入 415 至 466 Hz 之間的數值。

items.context: "Expert", not "Pro": the level is a Timbre Pro feature, so "Pro" read as the plan, not the precision.

items.key: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.source: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.translation: 簡易調音器只顯示調音功能。平靜模式會隱藏 XP、等級、任務與連續紀錄；你的星星和徽章仍會保留。

items.key: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.source: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.translation: 每天在你選擇的時間，輕輕提醒一次。

items.context: Note names follow the language until the player picks a system (German reads B natural as H).

items.key: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.translation: 麥克風音訊會在此裝置上分析，絕不儲存或上傳錄音。

items.key: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.source: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.translation: 僅分享功能使用情況，絕不包含音訊或可識別你的資訊。

items.key: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.source: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.translation: 嚴格信心門檻需要更清晰的音符才會顯示讀值。較大的分析視窗能讀取更低的音，但延遲會稍長。

items.key: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.source: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.translation: 歌曲練習使用貝多芬公有領域作品《歡樂頌》的一段樂句。

items.key: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.source: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.translation: 未標示出處的樂器皆為 Timbre 以程式碼建模並算繪。

items.key: Recorded instruments, shared under CC0 by their makers.

items.translation: 由製作者以 CC0 授權分享的樂器錄音。

由 Shahrad Azeri Sharghi 開發

items.source: Session dates, selected instruments and measured practice summaries are stored locally. They help you return to an instrument and review your practice. Clearing this app's storage in Android Settings removes local history and preferences.
items.translation: 練習日期、選取的樂器和測量所得的練習摘要會儲存在本機，方便你再次練習同一種樂器並回顧練習。在 Android 設定中清除此 App 的儲存空間，會移除本機紀錄與偏好設定。

items.source: Microphone sound is analysed on your device to estimate pitch. Audio is not saved or uploaded. Microphone access stops when you leave an active tuning or practice screen. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
items.translation: 麥克風聲音會在你的裝置上分析，以估計音高。音訊不會儲存或上傳。離開正在使用的調音或練習畫面後，麥克風存取就會停止。你可以在 Android 設定中撤銷權限。

items.source: The full instrument collection, singing practice and Studio are available through one permanent purchase, with no recurring charge. Google Play handles payment and purchase restoration. Open Purchase and restore in Settings to restore your access. If you already own an older subscription, its management remains available through Google Play.
items.translation: 一次永久購買即可使用完整樂器收藏、歌唱練習與工作室，無須定期付費。Google Play 會處理付款與購買項目回復。若要回復存取權，請在設定中開啟購買與回復。若你已擁有舊版訂閱，仍可透過 Google Play 管理。

items.source: Review access is active on this device.
items.translation: 此裝置已啟用審查存取權。

items.source: Instrument tuning, voice practice and rhythm tools.
items.translation: 樂器調音、嗓音練習與節奏工具。

items.translation: 音高讀值會受麥克風、環境噪音與樂器影響。請等讀值穩定，再輕輕調音。歌唱回饋會測量音高與穩定度，不是醫療評估，也不代表氣息支撐的測量。

items.translation: 免費樂器仍可使用。若你預期此帳號應有存取權，請回復購買項目。
